tagline: CartLens is an AI-powered price intelligence platform designed to bring transparency to physical retail shopping
description: CartLens is an AI-powered price intelligence platform designed to bring transparency to physical retail shopping. The platform helps consumers determine whether they paid a fair price by analyzing shopping receipts and product price tags using artificial intelligence, computer vision, and crowdsourced pricing data. Unlike traditional coupon, cashback, or budgeting applications, CartLens focuses on answering one critical question every shopper has after making a purchase: "Did I overpay?" **Key F
